headline.title: Lightscape opens tonight at Brooklyn Botanic Garden
headline.body: The winter light trail through the garden starts its season tonight and runs to Jan 3. Book timed tickets ahead, since popular nights sell out.

picks.title: Lightscape returns to Brooklyn Botanic Garden
picks.body: The garden's winter light trail opens today and runs to Jan 3. Timed tickets are bought in advance online, and popular nights can sell out.

picks.title: NYC Winter Lantern Festival opens in Queens
picks.body: Lantern displays light up Queens County Farm in Glen Oaks, 5 to 10 PM, starting Thursday. End date is listed as Jan 3.

picks.title: The Photography Triennial: After Dark opens
picks.body: The Museum of the City of New York looks at the city's nightlife through contemporary photography, opening to the public today.
picks.meta: Museum of the City of New York · admission
picks.place: Museum of the City of New York, East Harlem

picks.title: Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses
picks.body: The Brooklyn Museum's show of the Dutch designer's couture, 140-plus pieces, closes Dec 6. Plan a visit before it does.

picks.title: Faces: Moving-Image Portraiture at Anthology
picks.body: Anthology Film Archives runs a series on the human face in cinema, from today through Dec 1. Check the calendar for the film lineup.

picks.title: Resavoir at Baby's All Right
picks.body: The Austin jazz-leaning collective plays the Williamsburg room on Saturday. Tickets listed from $20.

picks.title: Historic New York: a Greenpoint history walk
picks.body: NYC Parks rangers lead a walk on the neighborhood's industrial past and immigrant communities, ending at WNYC Transmitter Park.

picks.title: Greenpoint-McCarren Park Greenmarket
picks.body: The Saturday farmers market sets up on Union Avenue between Driggs and N 12th Street.

picks.title: Brooklyn Flea at the DUMBO Archway
picks.body: Vintage, makers and food stalls every Saturday and Sunday, 10 AM to 5 PM, under the Manhattan Bridge archway. Free to enter.

picks.title: Shop Small Greenpoint Fall Retail Crawl
picks.body: Pick up a passport at any participating shop and collect stamps across 60-plus Greenpoint businesses over nine days.

facts.t: The SS Great Republic, launched from Henry Steers's Greenpoint yard on November 8, 1866, was then the largest ship of any kind ever built in the United States.

countdowns.title: 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
countdowns.body: Thursday, 8:30 AM to noon, from 77th Street to Herald Square. Free on the sidewalk.

countdowns.title: Shop Small Greenpoint crawl begins
countdowns.body: Nine days of stamps and prizes at 60-plus Greenpoint shops, Nov 28 to Dec 6.

countdowns.title: Rockefeller Center tree lighting
countdowns.body: The 2026 ceremony is Wednesday, Dec 2. Free, first come, first served.
